scope: Budget settlement only; local fixtures, no paid HTTP, no Git writes, no Docker mutations

interface.dispatch_enabled: BudgetedTransport keyword defaults True for compatibility; anything except literal True blocks before reserve/network
interface.snapshot: tokens/usd are net occupancy; reserved_tokens/reserved_usd preserve original reservation totals; requests never refunded; settled counts appended settlements
interface.settle: settle(attempt, *, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, response_sha256, source); no HTTP endpoint; immediate transaction; exact duplicate idempotent, conflict rejected
interface.legacy_complete: complete(id) retains conservative full charge and cannot later be settled
interface.migration: Exact original metadata/attempts SQL remains unchanged; transactionally append reservation_evidence and settlements tables; legacy rows lack evidence and remain fully charged
schema_v2: reservation_evidence(attempt_id PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES attempts(id), input_tokens INTEGER, output_tokens INTEGER)
settlements(attempt_id PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES attempts(id), prompt_tokens INTEGER, completion_tokens INTEGER, total_tokens INTEGER, usd TEXT, response_sha256 TEXT, source TEXT)
interface.trust: Only HTTP2xx, exact configured model, single valid finished choice, coherent nonboolean integer usage within original input/output bounds; reject malformed/duplicate JSON fields, provider error metadata, truncated or ambiguous responses
interface.sse: Incremental bounded events require valid model/delta/finish and unique coherent final usage, followed by terminal DONE with no later data. Accept documented final choice+finish+usage (no new content) OR older separate usage-only choices[] after finish. Reject early/duplicate/conflicting/error/truncated/missing-terminal usage.
interface.close: No settlement until stream exhaustion AND successful inner close; close serialized, idempotent; cancellation/errors remain uncertain and block admission
interface.privacy: Persist only scalar token/cost/hash/source metadata; transient JSON buffer <=1MiB, SSE events <=64KiB; no prompts, responses, keys or headers persisted
interface.json_message: Require message dict with content key, assistant role when supplied, string content for stop; null content only with finish-matching typed native tool_calls/function_call. Reject malformed or missing content and call structures.
interface.sse_delta: Every nonempty choices event requires delta dict, optional assistant role and str-or-null content; streamed native tool/function fragments have typed nonboolean indices and string name/arguments fields. Empty final delta valid. Final usage can accompany finished empty choice delta or follow in a separate usage-only event.
